2.5.4 applies here: the page listens to the device's motion (deviceorientation (www.halfords.com/…/motoring:331), deviceorientation (www.halfords.com/…/motoring:331), deviceorientation (www.halfords.com/…/motoring:331), deviceorientation (www.halfords.com/…/motoring:331), addEventListener("deviceorientation") (www.halfords.com/…/main.js)). Check that whatever is done by moving or tilting the device can also be done with a control on the screen, and that responding to motion can be turned off to avoid accidental actuation, unless the motion is essential or goes through an accessibility-supported interface (WCAG 2.5.4). If the script only collects data (analytics, fraud checks) and nothing on the page responds to motion, 2.5.4 does not apply.
